name: volcengine-plugins
description: Independent Volcengine MCP tools for images, videos, enhancement and fine subtitle erasure.

interface.shortDescription: 生图、视频、超分、精细化去字幕与本地画质复查。
interface.longDescription: Independent wrapper for official Volcengine APIs: Seedream images, Seedance videos, MediaKit standard/generative enhancement, and standalone fine subtitle erasure with v5 Quality defaults. Includes source upload, offline preview, task query and unchanged result download. Existing reference-video workflow retained. Separate MediaKit credentials; no automatic paid retries or model fallback. Local source preflight, observed rectangle planning, texture/audio QC evidence and separate publishing export included.
defaultPrompt: Check Volcengine image, video, enhancement and subtitle erasure capabilities and configuration.
Remove only hard subtitles with the fine v5 service; preview first and preserve audio and timing.
Plan a reference video with $reference-video-production before authorized generation.
